title: hopea sphaerocarpa
intro: Hopea sphaerocarpa, commonly known as the spherical-fruited hopea, is a plant species belonging to the family Dipterocarpaceae. The health benefits of Hopea sphaerocarpa include its potential to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against oxidative stress and inflammation-related diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been reported to possess antimicrobial, anti-proliferative, and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents of Hopea sphaerocarpa have been found to include flavonoids such as quercetin and kaempferol, phenolic acids like gallic acid and ferulic acid, and terpenoids including α-amyrin and β-amyrin.
